# 0.8.0-alpha02

> **Alpha, not tested on a phone yet.** Unit tests pass; the fixes below come from the owner's phone pass of alpha01 but the build itself hasn't been on a device. Expect bugs and report them on GitHub.
>
> Version `0.8.0-alpha02` (`1800002`). Installs as **Editotsu α** (`ani.editotsu.beta`) and updates alpha01 in place.

- **New Features:**
  - Editotsu has its own face now
    - New launcher icon for every channel: teal for stable, amber for beta, red for alpha
    - New animated splash, status-bar icon and themed (monochrome) icon
    - Dantotsu's icon is retired with honours
  - Advanced settings open where you are
    - Every section with advanced options ends in "Show N more" and opens them right there. No more scrolling to the bottom and back up
    - Sections stay open after a setting restarts the app (DNS, proxy)
  - AniList settings now look like the rest of Settings. Custom lists are edited in a dialog
  - Storage usage and the subtitle preview sit inside their section cards

- **Bugfixes:**
  - Disclaimer and Privacy policy closed the app. They open now, so you can finally read them
  - Picking a DNS closed the advanced settings it lives in
  - A setting opened from search could stay dimmed until you left Settings
  - "Try Internal Cast (Experimental)" lost its second line on some phones
  - Cards in Tracking and Data and Storage stuck to the next card
  - Storage bar showed a lone dot instead of a track

- **Known issues:**
  - A torrent you haven't played before can still take 5 to 30 seconds to start on a slow swarm, and long seeks are slow
  - The picker filter sheet wears the default sheet colour instead of the picker's
  - AnimeThemes can take up to a minute the first time you open a show
  - The extension settings screen still looks like it did in Dantotsu; a redesign comes before the stable release
  - The Android TV launcher banner is still Dantotsu's
  - The Degoogle'd build has no in-app updater

- **Which apk?**
  - `Editotsu-0.8.0-alpha02-google-arm64-v8a.apk`: most modern phones
  - `Editotsu-0.8.0-alpha02-google-universal.apk`: other architectures
  - `Editotsu-0.8.0-alpha02-fdroid-arm64-v8a.apk`: Degoogle'd, most modern phones
  - `Editotsu-0.8.0-alpha02-fdroid-universal.apk`: Degoogle'd, other architectures
